P5.notes: OPERATOR DECISION: batch every evaluator change into one era event. Order: (1) B5-03 FIRST: normalize the evaluator fingerprint (AST of each .py with docstrings stripped and include_attributes=False; canonical JSON of yaml.safe_load for YAML), bump INFRA_FINGERPRINT_SCHEMA_VERSION, stamp evaluator_digest_method on the fingerprint, add the test that fails when a module defining scoring entry points sits outside DEFAULT_EVALUATOR_PATHS, and make compare_infra_fingerprints report an old-method vs new-method pair as UNVERIFIED (not NON_COMPARABLE) so the switch is legible. (2) The bugs. (3) Perf. (4) The structural refactors. The four evaluator files are UNLOCKED for this package only. Every commit subject touching them starts with 'evaluator-era:'. Your final report must contain a short operator note: what changes in scoring/telemetry semantics (if anything) vs. pure refactor, and that merging this package is the single AP-55 regime break.

K3.title: AutoKernel prune of the three unreachable planes (operator decision 2026-10-24)
K3.notes: OPERATOR DECISION: delete all three unreachable planes, but stay CURRENT WITH MAIN. At the start of EVERY stage: `git -C <wt> fetch origin main && git -C <wt> rebase origin/main` (resolve conflicts; if another session changed a module you are deleting, re-check whether it became live). Then re-prove unreachability at that HEAD: compute the static import closure (including lazy/function-local imports, importlib.import_module strings, `python -m` strings, subprocess argv, systemd/deploy units, Makefile/yaml/doc-instructed commands, and epyc-root/epyc-orchestrator importers) from every live entry point: loop/serial_run.py, loop/run.py, loop/resume.py, the hand-run fold instruments, scripts/benchmark/* importers, actor_tools_mcp, the gdb probes, and O:scripts/autokernel_actor_cli.py. Write the closure and the delete list to <scratch>/K3/closure-stageN.txt. Delete a module only if it is outside the closure; delete its tests with it; re-home the thin bridges (C2-03) instead of keeping dead modules alive. NEVER delete the three evaluator modules that the epyc-root strip plan wrongly marks dead (C4-01): they are live. Journal kinds used only by the dead plane are retired first (C2-05) so old journals still validate (keep reading them; refuse new writes if that is the existing convention). Consumers in epyc-root (C2-M1: dashboard/campaign_status.py, vidya adapters) are NOT edited here: list them precisely in the report. Record LOC removed per stage (source and tests separately). Run the loop suite and the decision-arithmetic suite before and after each stage; the live-loop tests must not regress.

K4.title: AutoKernel regrowth guard and CI repair (operator decision 2026-10-24)
K4.notes: OPERATOR DECISION: repair the AutoKernel guards workflow so it can go green; the operator re-enables it in GitHub (do not try to enable it). Runs AFTER the prune (K3) merged: start with `git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main`. The guard must count all of autokernel/ (no 'uncounted library'), be a ratchet at the post-prune size, and fail on growth beyond a stated slack; the suite floors must be derived from current collection counts; workflow steps must be independent (each runs and reports even if another fails); install the yaml dependency; run ruff F-rules on the package. Run the workflow's commands locally exactly as the YAML does and show they pass.

O8.title: Orchestrator CI, honest gates, and the ni63 pin design (operator decision 2026-10-24)
O8.notes: OPERATOR DECISION: add orchestrator CI, triggered ONLY on pull_request and workflow_dispatch. It runs the hermetic suite (tests/conftest.py already stubs the kernel store and the host-RAM leg) with CI-appropriate workers on ubuntu-latest, deselecting a REVIEWED host-only list kept in a checked-in file with a one-line reason per entry (derive it from the baseline at <scratch>/orch_baseline2_failing_ids.txt plus the reasons in <scratch>/orch_baseline2.txt; anything that is real test rot is FIXED, not listed). Make `make gates` honest: format-check only the files changed vs origin/main (1,471 files would fail a whole-tree check), add ruff ASYNC to the lint selection if it is clean after O1. Also fix the ni63 source-pin design: tests/fixtures/ni63_capacity_child/source_clone.py byte-pins ~30 production files to a past commit and is already red on main (orchestrator_stack.py changed upstream). Keep the test's purpose (an isolated source clone of the import closure) but derive the closure's hashes from the checkout and RECORD them for provenance instead of asserting fixed values. A6-13 was partly done in O7; finish only what O7 left.
